anvil:aws:DynamoDB.description: Serverless key-value and document store. Secure-by-default DynamoDB table with GSI support, optional streams, and Lambda/EventBridge consumers. First data layer component — pairs naturally with anvil.aws.Lambda.

globalSecondaryIndexes.description: Global Secondary Indexes. All GSI key types must be explicitly declared — Anvil derives attributeDefinitions automatically from all declared keys.

kmsKeyArn.description: Tier 2 opt-in. ARN of a KMS CMK for encryption at rest. If omitted, AWS_OWNED_KMS is used (Tier 1 default — always on, zero cost). Use this for compliance workloads requiring key rotation control, audit trail, or the ability to revoke access by disabling the key.

stream.description: DynamoDB Streams configuration. Opt-in. Enables change data capture on the table.

ttlAttribute.description: Name of the attribute used for TTL (time-to-live). Items with this attribute set to a past Unix timestamp are automatically deleted by DynamoDB.

streamArn.description: The ARN of the DynamoDB stream. Only present when stream is enabled.

tableArn.description: The ARN of the DynamoDB table.

tableName.description: The physical DynamoDB table name. Scoped as {name}-{stage}.

anvil:aws:DynamoDBGlobalSecondaryIndex.description: A Global Secondary Index. All key attributes must use the explicit { name, type } shape — Anvil merges these into the table attributeDefinitions automatically.

hashKey.description: GSI hash key. Must include name and type explicitly.

nonKeyAttributes.description: Non-key attributes to project. Only valid when projectionType is INCLUDE.

rangeKey.description: GSI range key. Optional. Must include name and type explicitly.

anvil:aws:DynamoDBKeyAttribute.description: A DynamoDB key attribute with an explicit name and type. All keys — table and GSI — must use this shape. Anvil derives attributeDefinitions automatically.

type.description: Attribute type. S = String, N = Number, B = Binary.

enum.description: Only the table and GSI key attributes are projected.
Only the specified nonKeyAttributes are projected in addition to keys.

batchSize.description: Number of stream records to send to the consumer per batch. Defaults to 100.

consumer.description: The consumer of the stream. Discriminated union — exactly one of lambda or eventBridge.

startingPosition.description: Where to start reading the stream. Defaults to TRIM_HORIZON (AWS default — replays all existing records). Set to LATEST to only receive new events from the point of consumer creation.

viewType.description: The stream view type. Controls what data is written to the stream on item changes.

anvil:aws:DynamoDBStreamConsumer.description: Discriminated union for the stream consumer. Exactly one of lambda or eventBridge must be set.

eventBridge.description: Wire an EventBridge bus as the stream consumer via an EventBridge Pipe. Use this for fanout — the bus routes to multiple targets via rules. Bypasses the 2-consumer-per-shard limit of direct Lambda ESM.

lambda.description: Wire a Lambda function as the stream consumer via AWS-managed Event Source Mapping.

anvil:aws:DynamoDBStreamEventBridgeConsu.description: EventBridge Pipe consumer. Anvil creates the Pipe, a scoped IAM role for the Pipe, and wires the stream to the target bus. Use this for fanout to multiple targets via EventBridge rules.

busArn.description: ARN of the target EventBridge event bus.

name.description: Name of the target EventBridge event bus (anvil.aws.EventBus).

anvil:aws:DynamoDBStreamLambdaConsumer.description: Lambda stream consumer. Anvil creates the ESM, lambda:InvokeFunction permission, and attaches stream read permissions to the Lambda role. Does not grant table read/write access — call grantRead/Write separately if needed.

lambdaRoleArn.description: ARN of the Lambda execution role. Anvil attaches an inline policy granting stream read permissions (GetRecords, GetShardIterator, DescribeStream, ListStreams).

enum.description: Start reading from the oldest available record in the stream. Replays all existing records up to 24hr retention window. AWS default.
Start reading from the most recent record. Only processes new events from the point of consumer creation.
Only the new item image is written to the stream.
Only the old item image is written to the stream.
Both old and new item images are written to the stream.
Only the key attributes are written to the stream.

attributes.description: Set of nested attribute definitions. Only required for `hash_key` and `range_key` attributes. See below.

billingMode.description: Controls how you are charged for read and write throughput and how you manage capacity. The valid values are `PROVISIONED` and `PAY_PER_REQUEST`. Defaults to `PROVISIONED`.

deletionProtectionEnabled.description: Enables deletion protection for table. Defaults to `false`.

globalSecondaryIndexes.description: Describe a GSI for the table; subject to the normal limits on the number of GSIs, projected attributes, etc. See below.

globalTableWitness.description: Witness Region in a Multi-Region Strong Consistency deployment. **Note** This must be used alongside a single `replica` with `consistency_mode` set to `STRONG`. Other combinations will fail to provision. See below.

hashKey.description: Attribute to use as the hash (partition) key. Must also be defined as an `attribute`. See below.

importTable.description: Import Amazon S3 data into a new table. See below.

localSecondaryIndexes.description: Describe an LSI on the table; these can only be allocated _at creation_ so you cannot change this definition after you have created the resource. See below.

name.description:
Unique within a region name of the table.

The following arguments are optional:

onDemandThroughput.description: Sets the maximum number of read and write units for the specified on-demand table. See below.

pointInTimeRecovery.description: Enable point-in-time recovery options. See below.

rangeKey.description: Attribute to use as the range (sort) key. Must also be defined as an `attribute`, see below.

readCapacity.description: Number of read units for this table. If the `billing_mode` is `PROVISIONED`, this field is required.

region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration.

replicas.description: Configuration block(s) with [DynamoDB Global Tables V2 (version 2019.11.21)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/globaltables.V2.html) replication configurations. See below.

restoreDateTime.description: Time of the point-in-time recovery point to restore.

restoreSourceName.description: Name of the table to restore. Must match the name of an existing table.

restoreSourceTableArn.description: ARN of the source table to restore. Must be supplied for cross-region restores.

restoreToLatestTime.description: If set, restores table to the most recent point-in-time recovery point.

serverSideEncryption.description: Encryption at rest options. AWS DynamoDB tables are automatically encrypted at rest with an AWS-owned Customer Master Key if this argument isn't specified. Must be supplied for cross-region restores. See below.

streamViewType.description: When an item in the table is modified, StreamViewType determines what information is written to the table's stream. Valid values are `KEYS_ONLY`, `NEW_IMAGE`, `OLD_IMAGE`, `NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES`. Only valid when `stream_enabled` is true.

tableClass.description:
Storage class of the table.
Valid values are `STANDARD` and `STANDARD_INFREQUENT_ACCESS`.
Default value is `STANDARD`.

tags.description: A map of tags to populate on the created table. If configured with a provider `default_tags` configuration block present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.

ttl.description: Configuration block for TTL. See below.

warmThroughput.description: Sets the number of warm read and write units for the specified table. See below.

writeCapacity.description: Number of write units for this table. If the `billing_mode` is `PROVISIONED`, this field is required.
